cross_references.note: §1401 authentication is required before admission (layer 1 gate). §1402 altered document burden is layer 2 gate. Both must be cleared for admission. §1400 defines what authentication means.
Business records that appear altered fail §1402 AND §1271(d) (trustworthiness). Both arguments run concurrently against suspect business records like the wrong CARFAX.

MC-350 form absence: the PC §1368 court-ordered evaluation produced without mandatory Judicial Council form triggers §1402 burden. The proponent of the informal evaluation must account for the deviation from the mandatory form.
Honeysuckle 19 unsigned documents: §1402 operates on each document that appears incomplete or altered. CIV §1572 actual fraud operates on the transaction as a whole. Both run concurrently.

OPD missing report: §1402 applies to any OPD records that appear altered to remove references to 6/2/2009 report. PC §134 (preparing false evidence) applies to the actor who removed/altered the records.
RedJag wrong CARFAX: §1402 burden on the dealer to account for producing a vehicle history belonging to a different vehicle. VEH §11713 dealer fraud is the independent substantive claim.
